ShaderNodePreset.Description: Digital screen look: the image as seen on a display up close, with RGB subpixel layouts for LCD, CRT, OLED and LED walls, adjustable pixel size, fill, roundness and glow, and dead pixels and panel variation, plus a reference input and two-point fit for matching a real screen. Contact: sinan@sinanvural.com
ShaderNodePreset.Name: Digital Screen

Uniform.ToolTip: Arrangement of the subpixels. RGB Stripe: LCD. Stacked: R, G and B stacked in each pixel. Delta: CRT shadow mask. Aperture Grille: unbroken stripes. PenTile and Diamond: OLED. LED Wall: small dies in a dark package. Quad: a 2x2 block per pixel.
Uniform.Name: screen_layout

Uniform.ToolTip: Width of one screen pixel, in image pixels. Need not be a whole number. Scales with the resolution.
Uniform.Name: pixel_size

Uniform.ToolTip: Height of a screen pixel relative to its width.
Uniform.Name: pixel_aspect

Uniform.ToolTip: Rotation of the pixel grid, in degrees.
Uniform.Name: grid_rotation

Uniform.ToolTip: RGB Subpixels: each subpixel lights its own channel, as on a real screen. Source Colour: the layout only shapes the light, and every subpixel shows the pixel colour untinted.
Uniform.Name: colour_mode

Uniform.ToolTip: Flips which pixels take turns: red and blue in PenTile and Diamond, the offset rows in Delta. Use it when the grid lines up with a reference but red and blue are swapped.
Uniform.Name: swap_phase

Uniform.ToolTip: Origin of the pixel grid. Drag the axis in the viewer, or paste Action tracker data with Action Coords on.
Uniform.Name: grid_centre

Uniform.ToolTip: Read Grid Centre as Action coordinates: pixels from the image centre, as Action trackers give them.
Uniform.Name: action_coords

Uniform.ToolTip: How much of its slot each subpixel fills. Lower values widen the dark gaps between them.
Uniform.Name: fill

Uniform.ToolTip: Corner rounding of the subpixels. 1 makes square slots into circles and tall slots into capsules.
Uniform.Name: roundness

Uniform.ToolTip: Edge falloff of the subpixels, as a fraction of their size. Edges are anti-aliased at 0.
Uniform.Name: softness

Uniform.ToolTip: Light bleeding out around each subpixel, as on a screen seen through a lens.
Uniform.Name: glow

Uniform.ToolTip: Reach of the glow, as a fraction of pixel size.
Uniform.Name: glow_size

Uniform.ToolTip: Area: each screen pixel shows the image averaged over its own area, so fine detail does not flicker. Point: one sample at the pixel centre.
Uniform.Name: sampling

Uniform.ToolTip: Brightens the subpixels to make up for the light lost in the gaps. 1 keeps the picture average brightness, so small dots in big gaps get very bright. 0 is the raw mask.
Uniform.Name: compensation

Uniform.ToolTip: Overall brightness of the screen.
Uniform.Name: gain

Uniform.ToolTip: Colour between the subpixels.
Uniform.Name: gap_colour

Uniform.ToolTip: Set Pixel Size, Rotation and the grid origin from Point A and Point B. Place both on the same spot of two screen pixels in the reference, and enter how many pixels apart they are.
Uniform.Name: fit_points

Uniform.ToolTip: Screen pixels from A to B along a row. Spread the points as far apart as you can count accurately.
Uniform.Name: pixels_x

Uniform.ToolTip: Screen pixels from A to B down a column. 0 when both points are on the same row.
Uniform.Name: pixels_y

Uniform.ToolTip: Draw the outline of every screen pixel and the two points, to line the grid up with the reference. Turn off before rendering.
Uniform.Name: show_guides

Uniform.ToolTip: A spot on one screen pixel of the reference, such as the centre of a green subpixel. Uses Action Coords like Grid Centre.
Uniform.Name: point_a

Uniform.ToolTip: The same spot on another screen pixel, Pixels Across and Pixels Down away from Point A.
Uniform.Name: point_b

Uniform.ToolTip: Compare the result with the Reference input. Blend mixes them, Split shows the reference right of a line, Difference shows where they differ. Turn off before rendering.
Uniform.Name: reference_view

Uniform.ToolTip: Amount of reference in the Blend view.
Uniform.Name: reference_mix

Uniform.ToolTip: Position of the line in the Split view, across the frame.
Uniform.Name: split_position

Uniform.ToolTip: Fraction of screen pixels that stay dark.
Uniform.Name: dead_pixels

Uniform.ToolTip: Fraction of screen pixels with one subpixel stuck fully on.
Uniform.Name: stuck_pixels

Uniform.ToolTip: Random brightness change per screen pixel, up to this fraction either way.
Uniform.Name: pixel_variation

Uniform.ToolTip: Random brightness change per subpixel, which tints pixels at random.
Uniform.Name: subpixel_variation

Uniform.ToolTip: Screen pixels along each side of a panel, as in the modules of an LED wall.
Uniform.Name: panel_size

Uniform.ToolTip: Random brightness change per panel, up to this fraction either way.
Uniform.Name: panel_variation

Uniform.ToolTip: Random colour shift per panel.
Uniform.Name: panel_tint

Uniform.ToolTip: Picks a new random set of dead, stuck and varied pixels and panels.
Uniform.Name: variation

Uniform.ToolTip: What the matte output carries. Coverage: white on the subpixels, black in the gaps. Source Alpha: the input alpha passed through.
Uniform.Name: matte_mode

Uniform.ToolTip: Samples per pixel. Edges are anti-aliased at 1; more samples help very small or rotated pixels. Higher is slower.
Uniform.Name: samples

Uniform.ToolTip: Front: the input as it arrives. Pixel Colour: the colour each screen pixel shows, without the mask. Mask Only: the subpixel pattern on a white picture.
Uniform.Name: debug_mode
